keyFindings.description: The draft term is matched by two regexes: NEUTRAL with a fullmatch per term (line 123) and DRAFT with a search over the raw condition (lines 126 and 735). A filters clause with the draft term ORed in, where the term only widens, is refused with 'skips a draft'. The check fails closed, and no workflow uses that shape. Cleanup: build NEUTRAL from DRAFT.pattern.

unready_triggers' normalisation (pull_request_target, list-form or string-form on:, types: [] and string types) has no permanent test case. The tester covered each one by hand at 32dd5458 (PR body, E2E (tester) round 3), and DeepReview2 did too.

Lines 565-566 say workflow_call carries no pull_request. The script says 'workflow_call from a push', and the called_draft case tests a pull_request caller. Also, draft-push-only (lines 710-714) repeats a shape the neutral loop already covers on its push fixture.

Lines 104-106: a same-sha workflow_dispatch run can replace a release's pending call. That run builds the same commit, but it has no legion_version input, so the release gets no <legion version> tag. The base had the same behavior (worker-image-<sha>, no cancel). The comment's claim that no commit is left without a pinnable sha- image holds. Recorded in the PR body's Not proven / risk.
